title: docs(changeset): the manifest serializer forwards seven keys per input, not six
body:
Fixes #10298
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Prose only, in the bodies of three **pending** changesets. Each had "`manifestFromConfigs` forwards exactly six keys per input" with six keys listed. Each now says seven keys and lists `of` too. The YAML frontmatter of all three is byte-identical: sha256 of each frontmatter block is the same before and after, and `check-changeset-overwrite` prints the same "declared at base" and "declares now" line for each file. No code, no test, no new changeset.

| pending changeset | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `.changeset/5905-componentinput-inputtype-tombstone.md` | exactly six keys per input — `name`, `type`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description` | exactly seven keys per input — `name`, `type`, `of`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description` |
| `.changeset/5905-componentinput-retire-constraint-keys.md` | same six | same seven |
| `.changeset/7493-componentinput-retire-label-defaultvalue-advanced.md` | same six | same seven |

The diff changes 5 lines across the 3 files. Nothing else in those paragraphs was rewritten.

## Why: premise re-checked on `origin/main` `8b1f0661`

- `manifestFromConfigs` in `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts` maps each input to exactly these seven keys. Here are the property lines, printed from the tree with the comment block above `of` omitted:

  ```ts
  name: i.name,
  type: canonicalizeInputType(i.type),
  of: i.of === undefined ? undefined : canonicalizeInputType(i.of),
  required: i.required,
  enum: i.enum,
  binding: i.binding,
  description: i.description,
  ```

- A pin re-derives that list from the serializer source: the test "reads the serializer source and finds the seven, and none of the three" in `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-keys-7493.test.ts`. The published guide `content/docs/guide/plugin-development.md` already says "the seven keys the manifest forwards".
- **These sentences went false after they were written.** The three bodies were true when they landed, in commits `453dbaad42` (2026-08-31), `1ec291c0d7` (2026-09-04) and `c6198c27bd` (2026-09-06T05:07Z). `of` landed later that day in `cf1d29e2fc` (2026-09-06T17:01Z). Its own changeset, `.changeset/8067-component-input-member-kind.md`, is also pending and says `sdui.manifest.json` "now carries seven keys per input instead of six". Without this change, the next release notes would contain both statements.
- **Each paragraph's conclusion still holds, re-read whole after the edit:**
  - An authored `inputType` cannot reach `sdui.manifest.json`.
  - Neither can an authored `min`, `max`, `step` or `placeholder`.
  - Neither can an authored `label`, `defaultValue` or `advanced`.

  None of those keys is `of`. In each paragraph the list now has seven entries and the count says seven.

## Sweep (dispatch Zone 2 item 2)

- **Pending changesets.** I listed every `.changeset/*.md` with `git ls-tree` at `8b1f0661` and read each file from the same commit. The bodies that name the serializer (`manifestFromConfigs`, `sdui-parser`, "manifest serializer", `sdui.manifest`, "per input") were checked for a count or a key list of what the serializer forwards per input. Only two kinds of hit came back: the three bodies edited here, and `8067-component-input-member-kind.md`, which already says seven. There is no other pending hit.
- **Published doc faces:**
  - `content/docs/**` is correct.
  - `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` repeats the stale six-key list. Per the dispatch, it is listed below and not edited.
  - Released `CHANGELOG.md` files have zero hits for the six-key sentence. As a control, a search for `ComponentInput` over the same files matches several of them.

## Gates, all run locally at HEAD `b2df78a3`

Each exit code was captured before any pipe, and the line quoted is the gate's own verdict.

| command | exit | verdict line |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | "No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed." (3 files changed, 0 published source, 0 changesets added) |
| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | "No pending changeset names a file this change touches." The self-contradiction reading covers 3 changesets this change modifies, all 3 declaring a package, and prints "Every package declared ... is either not negated in its own prose, or negated only in an ASPECT". The born-false reading finds 0 line addresses. No paragraph was flagged. |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` (report-only) | 0 | 3 modified, 0 added, 0 deleted. For each file, "declared at base" equals "declares now", so no declaration is lost. This is the deliberate prose-correction case in its header. |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | "No test source names a pending changeset." |
| `pnpm changeset:check` (fixed + no-major) | 0 | "All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group." / "No changeset declares a `major` bump." |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | "check-control-bytes: OK" |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 | "VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)" |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (the 3 paths) | 0 | "NOT GOVERNED" |

- `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --changed -` prints all 3 paths. `.changeset/**` is a test input through `scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-no-major.test.ts`, per `--list`, so the `ci.yml` test job's markdown second stage will run the shards. I ran that test file locally under the verify lock: 1 file, 7 tests passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Not owed and not run:** type-check, package tests and builds. This diff touches no package, only three `.changeset/*.md` bodies.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs` refuses for this repository (exit 2, "asked for objectstack-ai/objectui, but this checkout is objectstack-ai/objectstack"). I derived the gate list by hand from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`.
- A red `Spec Main Shape Gate` on this PR would be the known drift: objectstack main added a `doc` nav item type (objectui#10287). A repair is in flight as objectui#10315. It is not caused by this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- **The same stale six-key list, outside pending changesets.** Listed only: not edited and not filed. Each one omits `of` from what the serializer forwards.
  1. `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md`, in the `os:check` example under "ComponentInput types": "the manifest serializer forwards only `name`, `type`, `required`, `enum`, `binding` and `description`". This is a published doc face and a governed surface (`skills-catalog`). A comment earlier in the same block correctly lists `of` among the six writable keys.
  2. `packages/types/src/widget.ts`, in the `WidgetInput` divergence docblock, clause 2: "`sdui-parser`'s serializer forwards six keys (`name`, `type`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description`)". This is source in a released package, so editing it would owe a changeset.
  3. `packages/plugin-markdown/src/index.test.ts`, in the test "no longer authors `inputType`": "The manifest serializer forwards six keys".
  4. `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-constraint-keys.test.ts`, in the file header's "What was measured": "forwards exactly six keys per input".

  `packages/types/src/base.ts` and `component-input-retired-keys-7493.test.ts` have already been repaired. They say the serializer forwards "a fixed key list per input, `of` included since objectui#8067". That wording would work for the four above.
- **AGENTS.md #9.** The edited sentences still contain a number ("exactly seven"). I kept it because the card and the dispatch limit the edit to the count and the list. A changeset is dated by its release heading, and the pin named above is the instrument that re-derives the list.
- The release PR objectui#5400 includes these three files because it consumes them. It was not touched.
